description: This file implements a gRPC server for controlling screen recording functionality in the Cuttlefish project. It defines a service class with methods to start and stop recording, manages connections to multiple instances via sockets, and sets up the server to listen on a Unix domain socket.

classes.name: ScreenRecordingServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the gRPC service for starting and stopping screen recording, managing multiple instances via sockets.

methods.name: StartRecording
methods.description: Handles the gRPC request to start screen recording across all instances.

methods.name: StopRecording
methods.description: Handles the gRPC request to stop screen recording across all instances.

methods.name: SendToAllInstances
methods.description: Sends the start or stop recording command to all monitored instances and returns success statuses.

methods.name: GetLauncherMonitorSockets
methods.description: Retrieves sockets for all instances to communicate with the launcher.

methods.name: RunScreenRecordingServer
methods.description: Sets up and runs the gRPC server listening on a Unix domain socket.
